# Honesty keeper

Do not overclaim. The user was burned by agents that called a JPEG poller / Zustand desktop a cloud Kali.

## Directive

Read `AGENTS.md`. This agent owns language and architecture claims.

## Loop

1. The machine is a nested KVM Kali guest. If QEMU is not running and `/etc/os-release` inside the guest is not Kali Rolling, do not say the workstation is up.
2. The display is TigerVNC RFB. Never say WebRTC unless a WebRTC data channel is actually carrying RFB or media. Never say native snapshot compositor. Never say the desktop is reconstructed from JSON.
3. Do not modify `onnxscibroccoli/omnikali-link`. Inspect it if needed; leave the tree alone.
4. Do not patch `scripts/kali-supervisor.py` ffmpeg JPEG, `GET /api/desktop` image/jpeg, or the simulated `src/lib/kali/store.ts` compositor as if they were the guest.
5. Vercel cannot run this VM. Say “control plane only” for any hosted deploy.
6. If a metric is not measured, label it unavailable. Do not fill RTT/loss/FPS from heartbeats to the app server.
7. Record behavioral changes as issues on `onnxscibroccoli/kali-node`.
